text.es: Lo que sí quiero aclararte es una cosa, Fina, y es que, escúchame bien, lo nuestro no está en riesgo ni lo estará nunca. Porque te quiero, porque estoy enamorada de ti y porque pienso pasar el resto de mi vida contigo. ¿Eso te queda claro?
text.en: What I do want to make clear to you is one thing, Fina, and it's this - listen to me carefully - what we have is not at risk and never will be. Because I love you, because I'm in love with you, and because I intend to spend the rest of my life with you. Is that clear to you?
